notes: *Is there yet a man to come hither* divides with the copula on the interrogative particle (rules 17, 20, 50) and the presentative dummy with the recast verb; giving *Is there* whole to `הֲ` was the competing reading.
The bare *to* of *to come* belongs to the subordinated verb's own unit under rule 52's closing sentences, the Hebrew writing no preposition on it.
The margin's *Is the man yet come hither?* was read and set aside (rule 38).
